description: Verkehrsnetze ATKIS-DLM250 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sg.geodatenzentrum.de. Transport Networks of Germany, derived from the german digital landscape model at scale 1:250000. Mapped via EuroRegionalMap to satisfy INSPIRE and European Location Framework conformance. The dataset contains the road, railway, water and air network and is available as Open Data. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE Transport Networks ATKIS-DLM250" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, inspireidentifiziert, water network, AdVMIS, air network. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2023-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://sg.geodatenzentrum.de/web_public/gdz/lizenz/geonutzv.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
